decisions.rationale: Names one specific disease, G6PD deficiency, with the abbreviation G6PD in parentheses. The span is kept as given; the abbreviation is a synonymous form of the same disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum span); What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions)

decisions.rationale: G6PD Distrito Federal names one specific named variant form of G6PD deficiency, analogous to a particular form of a disease, and is not a family of diseases.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD Tepic names one specific named variant form of G6PD deficiency, a single defined condition rather than a class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD Castilla names one specific named variant form of G6PD deficiency, a single defined condition rather than a class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD A- denotes a specific named form of G6PD deficiency caused by the characteristic mutations described, so it is a single specific disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD deficiency is one specific disease with a single definition and no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Example 6 (C7 deficiency as Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD A - is a named specific form of G6PD deficiency (the A- variant) referring to one defined condition.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)

decisions.rationale: G6PD A - is again a named specific form of G6PD deficiency referring to one defined condition, here used as a haplotype-associated disease form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); Examples 1 and 15 (particular forms of a disease)
